claim: Another can combine with a plural head even where singular respecification is unavailable.
evidence_summary: Another three days allows a singular time-span construal. Another three bodies have been discovered retains plural agreement.
finding: The lexical distribution of another and singular measure agreement make different predictions.
inference: Does another license plurals only when their measure can be construed as one unit?

evidence.passage: §3.4, p. 354. Another can combine with a plural head even where singular respecification is unavailable.
evidence.example: Compare another three days with another three bodies have been discovered (p. 354 [74]). A time span can be conceived as one interval. Plural agreement is required whether the discoveries were simultaneous or separate.
evidence.establishes: A plural after another cannot always be explained by a singular measure reading. The two diagnostics apply to different phenomena.
evidence.note: Local source (working note, unpublished draft or local copy); not online.
